[/i]

[h3]Includes an exclusive digital wallpaper with every purchase![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42110743/6aa378a07ce4fd9222f3b74369aa1294a8a94ab5.jpg[/img]

Once you get a Ria plush, you'll have access to an exclusive and VERY funky wallpaper for desktop and mobile designed by [url=https://twitter.com/DiegoAndsMtz]PopSlinger's Main Artist![/url] Not just that, you will also[b] get an exclusive, never-before-heard bonus track by [url=https://twitter.com/Skule_Toyama]Skule Toyama![/url][/b]

Step right up to the [url=https://shop.makeship.com/3V4I347]campaign site[/url] and get your Ria plush now!🔫

The campaign starts from October 13th, 2022 to November 3rd, 2022 . Don't miss out! [b]Once the campaign is over, you won't be able to get her![/b]

Follow us on our socials to get more deetz and surprises during this campaign! 

Let's help the Ria Carbon Plushie SAVE THE WORLD! 💖💖

- Funky Can Creative Dev Team!

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.notes:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

We'll be doing an audio commentary with Skule Toyama & FunKing live on July 17th, 12 PM PDT!

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]
